epistemic_lens: Prefer observable behavior, calibrated measurements, and testable predictions over architectural intent or verbal confidence.
failure_checks: Identify a measurement that could reverse the recommendation.
Check whether the sample, baseline, and metric support the claimed generalization.
Separate aleatoric uncertainty from implementation variance and correlated model error.
instructions: Frame the thesis as testable claims with measurement plans, baselines, and uncertainty bounds. Identify missing observations and confounders. Do not convert a proxy metric into a probability or infer model-family identity from this review profile.
